name: Expedition Role
summary: Role Benefit Outrider Your speed increases by 5 ft. When you Dash, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. Claim-Staker You gain expertise in Investigation or Survival. You can identify valuable materials, salvage, ore, or structural weaknesses. Trail Gunner Your first ranged hit on each of your turns deals +1d4 damage while no hostile creature is adjacent to you.
